pairs.why: n53 says the zoom keys zoom 'keeping the center'; n50 says center moves to the look-vector hit on the first frame after a zoom stops. A reader can only pick one.

n35 says a new object assigned to camera.limits is not used for clamping; n48 (and n47) use limits.planetRadius / radiusMin, which attachGeospatialControls reads from the live camera.limits. A reader cannot tell which limits object the controls use.
n7: 'The camera starts at 4*planetRadius'; n20: 'If 4*planetRadius < 10 it starts at 10'.
n11: the next yaw/pitch/radius write 'that changes the value' applies the center; n44: 'the next yaw/pitch/radius write', with no such condition.
n27 gives attachConfigurableFreeControl's per-frame step as speed*max(deltaMs,1)/sqrt(100000) with no exception; n16 implies a fastMultiplier other than 1 changes the speed.

n37 says the free camera's pitch is clamped to +-(PI/2-0.01), so a reader concludes a controlled free camera can never look straight up; n51's vertical-view identity case still occurs under attachFreeControl when the camera was made looking straight up.

Both say 'Ctrl+arrows'. n53 says that for geospatial only a held ControlLeft/ControlRight counts, not the ctrlKey flag; n36 does not say which of the two the arc-rotate keys read (they read the flag).

unscoped_word.why: does not say per attachment; offsets on the camera are applied by any attached hook.
does not say that a fast key times fastMultiplier in the configurable control.
is true only of the camera's own setters, not of attachGeospatialControls.
means the ctrlKey flag of the last key event, unlike n53.
happens only on frames with a turn; neither creation nor hand writes are clamped.
leaves out a camera with no cached projection yet.
is only a write that changes the value.
only when the look vector hits the sphere in front of the eye; radius is clamped to the limits.
holds only while the zoom runs; n50's re-centre follows.
does not say the range; n17 gives reverse-Z 0..1, so 'NDC' can be read as -1..1.

lost.what: pitchMax default PI/2-0.01 dropped; n7 and n35 name pitchMax but no note now gives its value.
'not scene meshes' was weakened to 'with no mesh needed'. The code picks only the analytic sphere and ignores meshes, so the stronger, true claim (a mesh in the way does not block the pick) was lost.
the zoom inertia value 0.9 was dropped; n43 now says only that zoom coasts.
'allocates per call' was dropped as untestable, but it is true (multiplyMat4 returns a new matrix on every call).

the worked example (speed 1000: a 200 px drag gives no glide, a 3000 px drag glides) is gone. It showed that the look-glide cut-off depends on the move speed field, which 'speed*0.001' alone does not make plain.
'zoom along the look vector' became 'keeping the center', which is not true once the zoom stops (n50).
